subject: Business Models
title: Asset-Light Models
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Asset-Light Models.

hook.text: Airbnb owns no properties. Uber owns no cars. They're worth more than hotel chains and taxi fleets combined.

buildup.text: Asset-light models don't own inventory. They connect suppliers with customers through a platform.

discovery.text: Without owning assets, these companies scale faster and with far less capital investment.

twist.text: Asset-light means less control. A bad Uber driver or dirty Airbnb damages the brand they don't directly manage.

climax.text: Asset-light trades control for scalability. It works until quality problems force you to care about the assets.

punchline.text: No rooms, no cars, billions in value. Own nothing, connect everything.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off in asset-light models?
options: Faster scaling but less quality control
